summary: Body of a deceased woman found ~150 ft from her Ford Focus hatchback, located hundreds of feet off the roadway at the hairpin turn on the west side of Wolf Creek Pass (US-160 MM 162); identified by the Mineral County Coroner as Marlena Rena Mizell; preliminary autopsy findings: death by multiple blunt force injuries
location: Wolf Creek Pass, US-160 mile marker 162, hairpin turn on the west side of the pass
responding_agency: Mineral County SAR, Archuleta County SAR, Colorado State Patrol, Mineral County Sheriff Office, CDOT
notes: Crash date unknown; Mizell was reported missing from South Fork on 2021-01-02, discovery date 2021-02-23 used. Mineral and Archuleta counties SAR teams jointly responded. Identity initially withheld pending positive ID and family notification. CSP crash investigation; investigators did not believe foul play was involved. Source: CBI news releases; Pagosa SUN 2021-02-25 ("Remains found at site located off Wolf Creek Pass"). MERGE (run 454): Conejos County Citizen "Mizell daughters speak about efforts to find their mother" (opened 2026-09-14) — same incident; adds the family-search timeline (daughters' own search along Wolf Creek Pass MM 162, SFFR drone-assist request, New Mexico search-party leg), the Feb-24 body discovery by a skier, and El Paso Coroner confirmation (row currently says Mineral County Coroner per the SUN; both coroners cited across sources).
